notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.14
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements not unlocking after Steam API update. If you have been having issues with unlocking the world specific achievements, try going to the world related to that particular achievement and it should pop. Otherwise you can try to beat the last level of that world again. We apologize for the inconvenience this might have caused.
[*] Other misc. fixes
[/list]

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.11
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing some levels to not load correctly. If you had previously had issues loading level 88 and the bonus levels, this update should fix them. In case your progress is beyond unlocking the bonus levels, you might need to unlock them again by beating level 87, to unlock level 88, then beating that to unlock the bonus levels. We apologize for the grief this might have caused.
[*] Other misc. fixes
[/list]

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.10
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now drag bots around in the editor on keyboard and gamepad by holding the selection button while hovering the cursor over them.
[*] Music and Sound toggles in the Options menu will now save their state after closing the game
[*] Reworked how levels are auto selected after beating a level. Beating the final level of a world will also automatically select the first level in the next world.
[*] Fixed an issue with Crumble bots under certain circumstances that would block left & right movement.
[*] Fixed "Poof!" achievement not triggering, it should now trigger the next time the game is launched.
[*] Other misc. fixes
[/list]

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

Music and Sound toggles in the Options menu will now save their state after closing the game

notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.9
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Move counter on the Undo button would increment even if nobody moved. This was purely visual and did not affect the actual Move score, but has now been fixed.
[*] The Tweet button in the Custom Levels menu has been fixed
[*] Boxes no longer emit landing particles in midair
[*] Earning a Pony Badge will now show a notification in the world map
[*] Other misc. fixes
[/list]

Stay in touch, we'll have more news for upcoming patches soon!

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.8
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new Discord button has been added to the Main menu with a direct invitation to the official #AkiRobots Discord server
[*] A new Twitter button has been added to the Options menu with a direct link to the @akirobotsgame Twitter account
[*] An arrow will now show up above the world map page buttons when a new world is unlocked for better feedback
[*] Version number now shows in the initial loading screen
[*] An issue with the Snails would cause them to sometimes float in midair
[*] Snails would spam the landing sound under certain circumstances
[*] An issue with the Big Boxes and Hoverskulls would sometimes make the game unresponsive in certain situations
[*] Other misc. fixes
[/list]

Stay in touch, we'll have more news for upcoming patches soon!

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.7
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] New "Clear" button in editor; will delete all tiles and bots in the level
[*] Pressing a world map level button twice will enter that specific level
[*] When undoing or resetting levels, bots now face the correct way
[*] When about to delete or drag a bot in editor by clicking on it, a sound will now play for better feedback
[*] Pressing the Tweet button when a level hasn't been beaten will now show a notification popup
[*] Sometimes the interactable parts of the music played when it shouldn't, this has been fixed
[*] Unity version has been updated from 2020.1.0f -> 2020.1.17f
[*] Other misc. fixes
[/list]

Stay in touch, we'll have more news for upcoming patches soon!

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

notes.title: #AkiRobots 1.0.5
notes.content:
We have gotten some really great feedback from you already so here's the first small batch of improvements.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Move counter now properly resets between levels. You no longer see the last level's move count before making your first move on the new level.
[*] Level numbers now show up next to the level name
[*] Current level's Pony Moves shows in the pause menu
[*] Game version shows in the main menu
[*] Other misc fixes
[/list]
Stay in touch, we'll have more news for upcoming patches soon!

[b]With love from @FlatPonies[/b]

notes.title: 🚀 #AkiRobots has launched! 🚀
notes.content:
[h3]🚀 [b]#AkiRobots has launched![/b] 🚀[/h3]
#AkiRobots is now available on Steam for everyone to play! Grab it now while it's new and hot and get a 30% discount. 

Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/861520/discussions/]forums[/url] for any help, or go join our Discord server where we're a bit more active.

Also don't forget to check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2296080787]Level Sharing Guide[/url].

We've been looking forward to this date for a long time and hope to see some fun, quirky, engaging and challenging levels from all of you!

With love from the FlatPonies team <3
